# sessions


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Dhrona keeps every session, whatever program ran it, as an Aidialog
notebook. Importing converts a host’s own session record into that
notebook, and exporting converts the notebook into a form another host
reads. A host here is one of Ramabana, Claude Code and Codex.

## Import a session

Claude Code and Codex sessions are read with llmsurgery’s session
reader. Ramabana sessions are read from its history file through
[`capture`](https://Karthik777.github.io/drona/rounds.html#capture). All
three end up as the same kind of review notebook. With
`session='latest'`, the newest Claude session in the project folder, or
the newest Codex thread for the project, is used.

### import_session

``` python
def import_session(
    host, # `ramabana`, `claude`, or `codex`
    output, # review notebook path
    session:str='latest', # session id, prefix, or `latest`
    cwd:NoneType=None, # project directory for Claude or newest-session lookup
    history:NoneType=None, # Ramabana history path
    codex_home:NoneType=None, # optional Codex home
    name:NoneType=None, # dialog name
):
```

*Import one host’s session as an Aidialog review notebook.*

Checking the host name needs no Claude or Codex sessions on the machine,
so this test runs anywhere.

``` python
from fastcore.test import test_fail

test_fail(lambda: import_session('other', 'x.ipynb'), contains='host must be one of')
```

## Compile one dialog for each host

Each host takes a different form. Ramabana gets the prompt from
[`bootstrap_prompt`](https://Karthik777.github.io/drona/rounds.html#bootstrap_prompt),
because its command line cannot load prepared history. Claude Code gets
a native session it can resume. Codex gets native Responses API items;
llmsurgery cannot write a Codex rollout file yet, so the session cannot
be resumed.

*Convert a Dhrona notebook into the form a target host reads.*

## The common dialog

This small dialog shows the part that carries across hosts. One prompt,
one tool call, one result and one final reply survive the round trip
through an Aidialog notebook and convert to Codex items.

``` python
import tempfile
from aidialog.hist import chat2dlg, dlg2chat
from aidialog.msg_parts import Msg, Text, ToolUse, ToolResult

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
tool = ToolUse(id='call_1', name='search_code', arguments={'query': 'dialog history'})
msgs = [
    Msg('user', [Text('Find the dialog history contract.')]),
    Msg('assistant', [Text('I will inspect the implementation.'), tool]),
    Msg('tool', [ToolResult(id=tool.id, name=tool.name, text='Chat.hist stores canonical messages.')]),
    Msg('assistant', [Text('Urai uses canonical messages in Chat.hist.')]),
]
dlg = chat2dlg(msgs, 'portable', mx=None)
dlg.meta[REVIEW_KEY] = {'status': 'accepted'}
portable = tmp/'portable.ipynb'
_write_dlg(dlg, portable)
roundtrip = dlg2chat(clean_dialog(portable), plain=True)
assert [m.role for m in roundtrip] == ['user', 'assistant', 'tool', 'assistant']
assert roundtrip[1].content[-1].name == 'search_code'
assert roundtrip[2].content[0].text == 'Chat.hist stores canonical messages.'
roundtrip
```

    [Msg(role='user', content=[Text(raw=None, cache_control=None, text='Find the dialog history contract.', citations=None)], raw=None),
     Msg(role='assistant', content=[Text(raw=None, cache_control=None, text='I will inspect the implementation.', citations=None), ToolUse(raw=None, cache_control=None, id='call_1', name='search_code', arguments={'query': 'dialog history'}, server=False, text=None)], raw=None),
     Msg(role='tool', content=[ToolResult(raw=None, cache_control=None, id='call_1', name='search_code', arguments={}, server=False, text='Chat.hist stores canonical messages.')], raw=None),
     Msg(role='assistant', content=[Text(raw=None, cache_control=None, text='Urai uses canonical messages in Chat.hist.', citations=None)], raw=None)]

The Codex export keeps the same call id on the function call and on its
output.

``` python
items = export_session(portable, 'codex')
call = next(item for item in items if item['type'] == 'function_call')
result = next(item for item in items if item['type'] == 'function_call_output')
assert call['call_id'] == result['call_id']
assert call['name'] == 'search_code'
[(item['type'], item.get('role') or item.get('name')) for item in items]
```

The Claude conversion is tested without writing into the real Claude
session folder. `dlg2msgs` is the conversion that `dlg2sess` performs
before it writes the file.

``` python
claude_msgs = ant.dlg2msgs(clean_dialog(portable))
call = next(block for message in claude_msgs for block in message['content']
            if block.get('type') == 'tool_use')
result = next(block for message in claude_msgs for block in message['content']
              if block.get('type') == 'tool_result')
assert call['id'] == result['tool_use_id']
assert call['name'] == 'search_code'
[(message['role'], [block['type'] for block in message['content']]) for message in claude_msgs]
```

## What can move today

A Ramabana, Claude Code or Codex session can become a Dhrona notebook.
That notebook can become a resumable Claude Code session, a Ramabana
bootstrap prompt or Codex items. A resumable Codex session has to wait
until llmsurgery can write one.
